passives.name: Fused Test Subjects
passives.description: (Passive Effect) If not affected by debuffs, WG damage received is reduced by [Buff_V_4500350_4_2], and damage received is reduced by [Buff_V_4500350_4_1]. When a Light- or Dark-element enemy ends its action, removes all of the caster’s debuffs and increases the caster’s Priority by [Buff_V_4500350_4_3_3]. At the start of each turn, the caster’s Penetration and Critical Hit Chance increase by 20%. (Stacks up to 4 times) Curse/Fixed Damage dealt to bosses cannot exceed [Buff_V_armor_common_3].

passives.name: Amorphous Subject
passives.description: (Passive Effect) If not affected by Frozen, damage received is reduced by [Buff_V_4500350_5_1]. At the end of the turn, removes 1 debuff. When hit, Priority increases by [Buff_V_4500350_5_3_2].
